page.notes: Page is a single running-text column; no marginal notes and no headings. The first word is a fragment at the page start and is copied as seen. Long s has been written as plain s throughout (fi = si, eft = est, etc.). "sricam" at the top is doubtful. "interuētu" is doubtful. "funto-mnes" appears as printed (possibly "sunt o-mnes" with a space missing). The superscript "2" after "Diuinitat." and the "15." after "cap." are read as printed. Stray dot marks in the right margin and at the foot of the page are not printed text and are left out. The catchword "pos-" is read from the foot of the page.
